This week
Europe did the buying this week. Tenders rose from 5 to 30 on the week, nearly all of them public notices from Poland, the UK, Ireland and the Balkans, and the biggest award was Romania's US$2.2bn Cernavodă nuclear contract, which went to a Canadian-Italian-Korean consortium; the five largest awards went to Canadian, Irish, British and Indian contractors. If you sell into European power and rail, the bid calendar below is your next fortnight; if you buy, the award values are your benchmarks. On the water, Hormuz crude is back to pre-war volumes while Venezuela's barrels are being priced out by freight.
— Yi Huang, World Trade Pro

The week in one look

Oil, gas & LNG led the week with 33 new projects and US$1.1bn of named contract value; power & renewables next with 24.

Deals of the week

1 / 6
Nuclear Power Station Construction Work at CNE Cernavodă
Awarded  ·  🇷🇴 Romania  ·  US$2.2bn  ·  won by Candu Energy, Canadian Commercial Corporation, Ansaldo Nucleare, Korea
A US$2.2bn civil package for two CANDU units sets the European nuclear benchmark this year; the consortium will now place heavy civil, M&E and site-services subcontracts in Romania.
2 / 6
The Provision of Network Services and Works To Gas Networks Ireland
Awarded  ·  🇮🇪 Ireland  ·  US$1.0bn  ·  won by GMC Civil & Mechanical Engineering Ltd / Murphy International Limited
A US$1.0bn multi-year framework means GMC and Murphy, not the utility, will buy pipe, fittings and civils for Irish gas networks for years.
3 / 6
Civil Works within NGED Substations 132kV, 66kV, 33kV and 11kV Framework
Awarded  ·  🇬🇧 United Kingdom  ·  US$796m  ·  won by A I & Z A Grant Ltd / Alpha Construction Limited / Alun Griffiths (Con
A US$796m substation civils framework in the UK: the three named contractors are now the buyers of concrete, steelwork and site services across the NGED area.
4 / 6
Rekonstrukcija i izgradnja drugog kolosijeka Dugo Selo - Novska
Awarded  ·  🇭🇷 Croatia  ·  US$762m  ·  won by Afcons Infrastructure Limited
Afcons taking a US$762m Croatian rail line is an Indian contractor winning EU-funded work; track, signalling and OHLE suppliers should expect its enquiries.
5 / 6
Debr.-Ny.egyháza signaling and telecommunications
Tender  ·  🇭🇺 Hungary  ·  US$187m  ·  bids due 8 Oct  ·  buyer Építési és Közlekedési Minisztérium
Hungary's US$187m signalling and telecoms tender closes 8 October: a short window, so only bidders already qualified for Hungarian rail will make it.
6 / 6
Dam Construction for ПАВЕЦ 'Чаира' and Reservoir 'Яденица'
Tender  ·  🇧🇬 Bulgaria  ·  US$398m  ·  buyer Национална Електрическа Компания Еад
Bulgaria's US$398m Yadenitsa dam for the Chaira pumped-storage plant is heavy civil and hydromechanical work; a national utility buyer with a long tender.

freightwaves.com
What it means: More daily slots for the largest ships means shorter queues on the US Gulf to Asia route; LNG and grain shippers should see slot premiums ease.
